item.title: Actor Okemesi in coma following complications from drugs (VIDEO)
item.description: Nollywood comic actor and content creator, Okemesi, is in coma following complications for drugs he was given in a hospital. item.description: Tijjani Jobe, the member representing the Dawakin Tofa/Tofa/Rimin Gado federal constituency in Kano, was booed and escorted out of an All Progressives Congress (APC) ward congress in Tofa LGA. item.title: Benue seeks FG’s approval to rehabilitate ‘400 repentant bandits’
item.description: The Benue state government says it is seeking the approval of the federal government to set up a disarmament, demobilisation and reintegration (DDR) centre to rehabilitate “repentant bandits”. item.title: Nigeria’s FX reserves now $50.4bn - Cardoso
item.description: Olayemi Cardoso, the governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), says Nigeria’s gross external reserves have risen to $50.45 billion – the highest level in 13 years. Cardoso spoke at a press briefing after the 304th meeting of the monetary policy committee (MPC) of the CBN held on February 23 and 24. item.title: Popular Nigerian actor Okemesi is dead
item.description: Popular Nigerian comic actor, Bamidele Tope Saint, professionally known as Okemesi, is dead. Okemesi died at the hospital on Tuesday, February 24, 2026, at about 11:50 a.m. The actor died after spending a few hours in a coma following complications from drugs administered to him at the hospital. item.title: FG files fresh charges against Ozekhome over alleged use of fake Nigerian passport
item.description: The federal government has filed fresh criminal charges against Mike Ozekhome, a senior advocate of Nigeria (SAN), over alleged use of a fake Nigerian passport in a disputed property case in the United Kingdom (UK). The federal government filed a 12-count charge against Ozekhome at the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) high court, Abuja, on Tuesday.
